body:
Leonard,

The send list is done. It's in my Q4 2025 investor update folder as "Q4 update - send list" (Google Sheet, shared with you as editor): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/eb67cf6558b687a7/edit

This is the bridge round only, as of end of day Tue Sep 30 (PT). Here's how many are in each group:

- New investors: 0 firms, 1 angel (Anton Bernstein, $25K. His DocuSign Completed notice came in Sep 26, after the $40K envelope was voided.)
- In talks: 7 firms (GFR, a16z, Dentsu, T-Accelerate, NCsoft, Homa, Brightwater Games Fund) and 1 angel (Paul Heydon, $50K. His SAFE was still unsigned in DocuSign, so he isn't counted as a new investor yet.)
- Awaiting reply: 14 firms, 0 angels
- Keep warm: 3 firms (LVP, Hiro Capital, SciPlay), 0 angels

Things you might not expect:
- Hiro Capital: the Sep 23 call was with them, and Edith Vane passed on the bridge on Sep 26. That's why they're in keep warm rather than awaiting reply.
- SciPlay passed by phone to Robert yesterday. a16z stays in talks, because the speedrun rejection is the program's decision and doesn't count as their answer on the bridge.
- Build access: Dentsu and T-Accelerate are iOS only. Arthur found yesterday that the investor tester list was never attached to the Play internal test track, so none of them have Android yet. He plans to attach it with today's build. The other firms in talks have no internal build access.

I also added a Keep warm checklist to the Existing Investor Update card in Trello, with one item each for LVP, Hiro Capital and SciPlay.

Each row in the sheet has a short note on why it's in its group. We can go through them on Monday.

Fred
